participation.context: Stood at the dark window with the latch in front of you.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took the door, the weather on the window, and the tools on the stair, and no face.

title: Looked at the latch under repair and the tools

participation.context: Counted twenty shillings twice, tried the latch, and left the chronicle in the room.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Refused the latch-money, wrote the receipt, and set the terms for the empty chamber.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Not in the room. Named as forbidden the lord's book.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: the Christmas quarter, three days early
relations.quote: you have it now, three days early.
It is the house's latch, Master Shakespeare, and not the lodger's.

story.body: You counted twenty shillings twice and did not pay for the latch. She wrote the receipt and kept the coffer, the chamber, and the cat as her work while you are gone. You did not cast a new total.
